note: Fits the starting-point half of the ICP almost perfectly and misses the commercial half. Good-to-great is textbook and in his own words — 'when I look at myself in the mirror, I like what I see... I just know it can be better', 'it's almost there', 'one of the best shapes of my entire life' — and he explicitly rejects the bodybuilder end as well as the rescue end. Not deconditioned: daily morning mobility work for two and a half years, a background in BJJ, boxing and karate, self-managed nutrition with a 12-8 eating window. Health is the area he wants to advance rather than a crisis, so neglected_health holds in substance even though he is further along than most. He misses on occupation — inspecting construction sites is not the business-owner or physician profile the stated ICP names — and misses clearly on income as tested by affordability: no credit card, five children plus a dependent sister's family, a variable income component, and 'sometimes it's nothing' left at month end. Note also, against the ICP file's own observation that the stated ICP has no clinical criterion, that this prospect disclosed a metabolic syndrome diagnosis and a kidney-stone history and no criterion in the ICP would have surfaced it.
